QuestInfo.name: The Path of the Sage I
QuestInfo.0: Be sure to pack everything you need before you leave for town. Most importantly, don't forget to take your Master's book of magic with you.
QuestInfo.1: You learned some magic with the help of your Master's spell book. Now you've got some new spells rattling around inside of your head, waiting for you to try them out.
